sections.name: Collapse of the Well
rules: This is a defined cultivation-recharge procedure, not a short-rest or long-rest limit.

A higher-Source-CL Time, Fate, Void, Samsara, Boundary, Seal, Formation, divine, artifact, or conceptual authority can contest individual operations of the field. Ordinary anti-magic does not automatically erase it unless that effect also suppresses cultivation Source Rules.
sections.summary: When the field ends:

sections.name: True Yokai Form
rules: Assume your inherited true form. You retain your game statistics, equipment, actions, and identity unless a feature says otherwise. Equipment can merge cosmetically into the form or remain worn if physically compatible; it is not destroyed or duplicated.
You gain the benefits of Unmasking without paying its cost, your natural weapon die becomes 1d10, and gain the lineage package below.
sections.summary: Concentration: No

sections.name: Kitsune True Form
rules: - Resistance to Psychic or Fire damage, chosen when you transform.

- Ninefold Feint: Once per round when an attack misses you, move up to 15 feet and create a Dream Thread–like foxfire sign on the attacker. The sign lasts until the end of your next turn and lets you target it with Soul Gaze through ordinary invisibility within 60 feet.
sections.summary: - Fly Speed 40 feet; hover through foxfire steps rather than wings.

sections.name: Tengu True Form
rules: - Resistance to Thunder or Force damage, chosen when you transform.

- Mountain Wind Cut: Once on each of your turns after moving at least 20 feet, one creature you hit with your natural weapon takes an extra 2d8 damage and must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall Prone or be pushed 15 feet, your choice.
sections.summary: - Fly Speed 50 feet.

sections.name: Kappa True Form
rules: - Resistance to Cold or Bludgeoning damage, chosen when you transform.
- River Lock: A creature Grappled by you cannot teleport or use incorporeal movement unless its Source CL exceeds yours or it succeeds on a Charisma saving throw when it attempts to do so.
sections.summary: - Swim Speed 60 feet and can breathe air and water.

sections.name: Jorogumo True Form
rules: - Resistance to Poison or Psychic damage, chosen when you transform.

- Grand Silk: As an Action, create a 20-foot-square web zone within 60 feet until the end of the scene. The zone is difficult terrain for enemies. A creature that enters for the first time on a turn or starts there makes a Dexterity saving throw, becoming Restrained until the end of its next turn on a failure. A creature can use its Action to repeat the save, ending the restraint on success. You can have one Grand Silk zone at a time.
sections.summary: - Climb Speed 50 feet, including ceilings, and web-walking.

sections.name: True-Form Exposure
sections.summary: While in True Form, ordinary observers recognize that you are not wholly human, though they may not know the exact lineage. Identity concealment with equal or higher authority can alter this result; mundane disguise cannot.

sections.name: Unmasking
ordered: Reveal a combat-capable portion of your yokai nature. Your Tell becomes obvious and cannot be suppressed while the feature remains active.
sections.summary: Reveal a combat-capable portion of your yokai nature. Your Tell becomes obvious and cannot be suppressed while the feature remains active.

sections.name: Yokai Natural Weapon
rules: Once on each of your turns when you hit with the natural weapon or a creature fails its save against Mind Spike, deal additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus of your lineage affinity.
This is a weapon expression of your own body and soul. It is not a Sphere talent and does not count as a detached Cultivation Asset.
sections.summary: Choose an appropriate bite, claw, horn, wing-blade, tail, web-strike, water-heavy blow, or foxfire lash when you activate Unmasking. It is a simple cultivated natural weapon with which you are proficient. It uses Wisdom for attack and damage rolls, has a reach of 5 feet, and deals 1d8 + Wisdom modifier damage of your lineage affinity or an appropriate physical type.

sections.name: Unmasked Lineage Gift
rules: - Tengu: After you move at least 15 feet in a straight line, your next natural-weapon hit that turn deals an extra 1d8 Thunder damage and can push the target 10 feet.

- Kappa: You have Advantage on checks and saves against Grappled and Restrained. Once per turn on a natural-weapon hit, you may Grapple the target using your Cultivation Attack Modifier in place of Athletics.

- Jorogumo: Once per turn on a natural-weapon hit, place a Silk Thread on the target until the end of your next turn. While threaded, it cannot benefit from invisibility against you and has Disadvantage on the first check or save it makes to escape one of your movement or restraint effects.
sections.summary: - Kitsune: After you deal the additional damage, create one foxfire double in an adjacent space until the start of your next turn. The first attack against you before then has Disadvantage; on a miss, you may move 5 feet.

sections.name: Yokai Lord
rules: Concentration: No
Assume True Yokai Form and manifest a Yokai Court in a 30-foot aura centered on you.
sections.summary: You become a local sovereign expression of your inherited lineage rather than merely revealing an ancestral body.

sections.name: Court Authority
rules: - Such a hostile creature that first enters the aura on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Charisma saving throw.

- Failed Save: It is Overawed until the start of its next turn. While Overawed, it cannot take Reactions, cannot willingly move closer to attack you, and has Disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you.
- Successful Save: It suffers one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect.
- A creature repeats no save merely for remaining in the aura; it saves again only after leaving and reentering or when you use Lordly Challenge.
sections.summary: - Beasts, yokai, spirit-beasts, transformed creatures, and spiritually compromised creatures with lower Source CL know your lineage and broad emotional intent while in the aura.

sections.name: Lordly Challenge
rules: Choose one beast, yokai, spirit-beast, transformed creature, or spiritually compromised creature within 60 feet. It makes a Charisma saving throw.

- Failed Save: It follows one simple, non-suicidal command on its next turn: approach, withdraw, release, reveal, kneel, cease pursuit, or attack a creature already hostile to it. If it takes damage from you or your allies before complying, the command ends.
- Successful Save: It suffers one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect.

This is temporary lineage authority, not permanent taming, friendship, enslavement, or a companion bond. A substantially lower-Source-CL ordinary creature can be compelled for up to 1 minute if you maintain Concentration after the first failed save; it repeats the save at the end of each turn and whenever damaged.
sections.summary: Bonus Action, once per round

items: Kitsune — Palace of Foxfire: Once during the activation, create up to Proficiency Bonus illusory doubles in spaces within 60 feet. Until destroyed by a successful Investigation check against your Cultivation Save DC or struck by an attack, each double can serve as the origin of one non-hostile Spirit Awakening feature. You still activate each feature only once and pay all costs.

Tengu — Heaven-Scouring Descent: Once during the activation, move up to your fly Speed without provoking reactions and make one Cultivation Attack against every hostile creature whose space you pass within 5 feet of, maximum Proficiency Bonus targets. On a hit, deal 4d10 + Wisdom modifier Thunder or Force damage.

Kappa — Court Beneath the River: Once during the activation, create a 30-foot-radius water court centered on a point within 60 feet. It lasts for the scene, is difficult terrain for enemies, and permits you and willing allies to breathe, swim, and stand in it as though on solid ground. Hostile teleportation and forced passage across its boundary require a Charisma saving throw.

Jorogumo — Web of a Hundred Names: Once during the activation, choose up to Proficiency Bonus creatures you can perceive within 60 feet. Each makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, spectral silk links it to a point you choose in the Court. Its Speed becomes 0 until it uses an Action to repeat the save or an ally destroys the thread Anchor, which has AC equal to your Cultivation Save DC and Hit Points equal to 3 × Proficiency Bonus.

sections.name: Soul Splitting Expression — Masked Twin
sections.summary: While Soul Splitting is active, your Soul Fragment may display your Tell and use your Spiritual Sense. During Unmasking or True Yokai Form, the fragment may originate one natural-weapon attack you make, but this does not grant an additional attack or separate turn.

sections.name: Yokai Mask
ordered: Your inheritance can be hidden, displayed, or used as a social and spiritual instrument.
sections.summary: Your inheritance can be hidden, displayed, or used as a social and spiritual instrument.

sections.name: Suppress or Reveal the Tell
rules: When a creature attempts to determine whether you are lying about your species, ancestry, or spiritual nature, you may use Wisdom instead of Charisma for the relevant Deception check.
sections.summary: You may suppress or reveal your Tell as a Bonus Action. Suppression defeats ordinary visual inspection but not Spiritual Sense, Soul Gaze, a lineage-specific detector, or equal- or higher-Source-CL identity revelation.

items: Kitsune — Foxfire Misdirection: When a creature within 30 feet makes an Insight check against you or an attack roll against an illusion, reflection, or duplicate created by you, use your Reaction and spend 1 Resonance to impose Disadvantage. If the roll fails, the creature becomes Resonance Marked by you.

Tengu — Wind-Perched Step: Your jump distance doubles. When you fall, reduce the effective fall by 10 feet × Proficiency Bonus. As a Reaction when pushed or knocked Prone, spend 1 Resonance to move 10 feet to a legal space and remain standing.

Kappa — River Body: Gain a swim Speed equal to your Speed and can hold your breath for 1 hour. As a Reaction when you or an adjacent ally would be moved, spend 1 Resonance to reduce that movement by 10 feet and shift the creature 5 feet to another legal adjacent space.

Jorogumo — Wall-Clinging Thread: Gain a climb Speed equal to your Speed and can move across ceilings while leaving both hands free. Once on each of your turns when you Resonance Mark a creature, you may reduce its Speed by 5 feet until the mark ends.

sections.name: Yokai’s Bargain
rules: Action or 10-minute negotiation
The bargain forms only if both parties knowingly accept. Magical coercion that removes meaningful choice prevents formation unless the bargain’s Source Rule expressly allows coerced contracts.
Each party gains a visible-to-spiritual-senses Bargain Mark. A party can bear only one Bargain Mark from you at a time.
sections.summary: Yokai bargains are voluntary exchanges enforced by hospitality, appetite, clever wording, and spiritual face. They are not Oath-Ledger debts, Soul-Collateral Contracts, or Karma judgments.

items: Advantage on one defined category of skill check directly related to fulfilling the bargain.
A 10-foot increase to one movement mode while traveling toward the bargain’s objective.
Temporary Hit Points equal to 2 × Proficiency Bonus at the start of the first scene in which the bargain is actively pursued.
The ability to communicate telepathically within 1 mile for purposes related to the bargain.
Permission to cross one ward, threshold, territory, or hospitality boundary controlled by the other party, if that party has authority to grant permission.

sections.name: Permitted Benefits
sections.summary: The bargain may grant each party one of the following while it remains honored:

items: Impose Disadvantage on one d20 Test the violator makes within 60 feet.
Gain Advantage on one saving throw against the violator.
Learn the violator’s direction while on the same plane for 1 hour, unless blocked by equal or higher spiritual concealment.
Deal 4d10 Psychic damage to the violator as a Reaction when it directly benefits from the breach. The violator makes a Charisma saving throw, taking half damage on a success.
groups.lead: The claimant may spend the Claim in one of these ways:

sections.name: Breach
rules: A Yokai Claim cannot force future obedience, seize a soul, create unlimited pursuit, or punish an ambiguous technical breach. If the bargain’s meaning is genuinely disputed, resolve it through the stated terms, witnesses, and a Cultivation Check rather than automatic punishment.
sections.summary: When a party knowingly breaches, the nonbreaching party immediately knows the broad category of breach and gains one Yokai Claim against the violator. The Bargain Mark remains until the claim is used or the parties reconcile.
